description: Private-by-default macOS CLI for Apple Voice Memos metadata, embedded transcripts, export, and freshness-aware iCloud synchronization.

novel_features.name: Freshness-aware Voice Memos sync
novel_features.description: Triggers voicememod first, falls back to a hidden Voice Memos launch, reports explicit freshness evidence, and refuses ambiguous process cleanup.

novel_features.name: Embedded Apple transcript extraction
novel_features.description: Extracts Apple-generated tsrp transcript JSON locally from Voice Memos media without uploading or re-transcribing audio.

novel_features.name: Safe local export
novel_features.description: Copies one selected recording with private permissions while rejecting traversal and symlink destinations.
